Description.zh: 它能让你完成平时无法做到的痛苦或危险动作。还能帮助你更快地从沮丧或恐惧中恢复过来。
Description.en: Allows you to perform painful or dangerous actions you would otherwise not be able to do. It also helps you recover from being demoralized or frightened faster.
Description.ja: 普段怖くてできないアクションが、できるようになる。士気が落ちた時や、恐怖を感じた時の回復が早まる。

NotEnoughText.en: I haven't mustered enough courage yet...
NotEnoughText.ja: 勇気が足りない・・・
